faq.a: On the first page read: Aldergrove Town Centre (new Vanetta product at 27254 Aldergrove Town Centre Drive), Willoughby Heights (197 Street, 80 Avenue, 208b Street, 78b Avenue) and Langley City resale buildings (53a Avenue, 54th Avenue, 200 Street, Fraser Highway). faq.q: Which school district serves Langley, and how are catchments set?
faq.a: SD35 Langley; catchments are address-based — at the recorded Willoughby sample (7888 200 Street) the locator gives Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, Peter Ewart Middle School and R.E. Mountain Secondary; no catchment for the specific Aldergrove Town Centre or Langley City condo addresses on this page is on record in this file, so confirm any address with the SD35 School Locator (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/verification/catchment-addresses-by-district.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Langley?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Langley?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.
